notes.title: We've Released - Join our Discord Server!
notes.content:
Thanks to all our backers and wishlisters - As far as we know, this is the first Apple II game to ever release on Steam!

Be sure to [url=http://discord.noxarchaist.com/]join our Discord server[/url] to chat with other players and the developers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39478450/1f92ee09c60e77fcf612dfae41fa58c2eff0f0af.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nox Archaist release is Thursday, Jan 28, 8am Pacific (GMT-8)
notes.content:
[h2]The Dark Shadow says to buckle on your sword and dust off your spellbook. Nox Archaist release is less than 24 hours from now!
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39478450/4e15d0799c2c6e1726fc683da7312dac2d2b5b31.gif[/img]

notes.title: Nox Archaist coming soon!
notes.content:
Our store page has been approved! Visit here to add Nox Archaist to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1509080/Nox_Archaist/

Our release date on Steam is Jan 28. Looking forward to seeing all of you in the chat rooms and posting screenshots once the game goes live!
